configurePresets.name: microchip_curiosity
configurePresets.description: Size-optimized build for Microchip Curiosity Nano Board (default)

cacheVariables._comment_build_type: MinSizeRel, NOT Release. The toolchain puts -Os in CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT; CMake appends CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_<CONFIG> after it, so Release's -O3 would win and cost ~28 KB of flash (22% of this 128 KB part). MinSizeRel appends -Os -DNDEBUG, which agrees with the toolchain.

configurePresets.name: native-ut
configurePresets.description: Native debug build with unit tests enabled

buildPresets.name: native-ut
buildPresets.description: Build the native unit test executables

testPresets.name: native-ut
testPresets.description: Run the native unit tests via ctest

exclude._comment1: MicroFsFullTest / MicroFsFileTest / TmFramer_ut_exe are EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL in CMakeLists.txt because the libraries they link do not compile at the pinned fprime-baremetal / fprime-samd commits. register_fprime_ut() registers add_test() regardless, so the binaries would never exist and ctest would report them as NOT RUN. Drop these when the exclusions go.
exclude._comment2: ThinBufferManager_ut_exe BUILDS fine but aborts on an upstream fprime-samd bug, not a defect in this repo: its tester hardcodes TEST_ALLOCATOR_BUCKET_SIZE = 840, sized from a measured 48-bytes-per-slot sizeof(AllocatedBuffer) on Darwin x86_64/arm64. On Linux x86_64 the slot is wider, the bucket overflows and StaticMallocator asserts during setup. Reproduced identically against moonfall-power-manager, so it predates this port. Remove once fprime-samd derives that constant with sizeof() instead of a hardcoded number.
exclude.name: ^(MicroFsFullTest|MicroFsFileTest|fprime-samd_Svc_TmFramer_ut_exe|fprime-samd_Svc_ThinBufferManager_ut_exe)$
